messages.text: Searched the catalog · Harlo H15 Dual Bitcoin Dogecoin
Read the harlo h15 dual page

Happy to. Two things first, both worth knowing.

The H15 Dual isn't buyable yet: Batch 1 is 50 units, opens Wednesday Sept 30 at 12pm ET, and ships November 14. $999, 15 TH/s Bitcoin plus 1.08 GH/s Scrypt for Doge, about 450W at the wall.

For the numbers I need your rate, and rates swing hard. Tell me your state or country (or your cents per kWh if you know it) and I'll give you sats stacked per month, power cost and the solo-block odds.
what are the differences between this and the magic miner

Main difference is what they mine. The H15 does both: 15 TH/s Bitcoin plus 1.08 GH/s Scrypt for Doge/Litecoin, one box, $999, about 450W.

The Magic Miner 40T is Bitcoin only, but it's a lot more of it: 40 TH/s for $799, tunable 30 to 50 TH/s (450W to 850W), BM1370 chips. Roughly $20 per TH against $67 on the H15.

Both ship November 14. The 40T you can order now, the H15 opens Wednesday noon ET.

So: Doge in the mix, or the most Bitcoin hashrate per dollar?
